facts.anchor: I thought about what Roddie had said. I thought about it a lot. I thought about Negasi, and how satisfying it had been to work with him, moving one step at a time, building his business plan
facts.fact: 她反复消化 Roddie 的话：Negasi 的 vision 正在成形（一步一步搭他的商业计划），照见了她自己的 vision。

facts.anchor: I took Folami out for drinks and laid all my cards on the table.
facts.fact: 她与 Folami 摊牌：远程过渡不撂挑子、长期想做 launching side（助创业那一侧）。

facts.anchor: “I wouldn’t leave you in the lurch. I could work remotely. But I think my long-term goal is to do something like what you’re doing. I like this client base you’re cultivating, but I want to
facts.fact: Folami 的 partnership 提议：她们缺一个懂税务的会计——「See if Cameron's available」成为两人的内部笑话。

facts.anchor: Working with small businesses and entrepreneurs wasn’t as lucrative as corporate clients, but the work was more personal. More challenging and more rewarding.
facts.fact: 她确认自己「真的喜欢那个数字」（PLF 内部笑话：God, I was happy to be out of that place）。

facts.anchor: “Victoria isn’t Toronto. Whatever I build will be slow. It’d be at least a year before I could even think about striking out on my own.”
facts.fact: 被问「You really like this guy?」她的答案：离婚后第一个且唯一的约会对象、尽量不急，但 I miss him so much。

facts.anchor: “Maybe we should talk about a partnership,” Folami suggested.
facts.fact: Falami 的追问让她把 Dogwood 的故事（怎么讲、怎么落地）全部倒出来——spilling the tea。

facts.anchor: “Maybe.” She shrugged. “If only we knew a good accountant who could explain the tax implications.”
facts.fact: 她的坦承：她从不给 Zak 发照片，怕被发现自己一有空就看他——这是她最后的保留。

facts.anchor: “I’ll call PLF. See if Cameron’s available.”
facts.fact: 本章以新问题收尾：如果换到「launching side」，她愿不愿意从零开始？答案尚未给出。
